scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && electron .
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android && node scripts/package-model.mjs --optional
scripts.android:build: npm run ai:source && npm run android:sync && node scripts/package-model.mjs && node scripts/android-build.mjs
scripts.android:build:ui: npm run ai:source && npm run android:sync && node scripts/android-build.mjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.desktop:package:ui: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs --ui-only
